findings.body: In src/sentry/monitors/logic/incident_occurrence.py line 159, the function get_monitor_environment_context copies the monitor config dict but then returns the original monitor.config instead of the copied and potentially modified config. This means the schedule_type display update is not reflected in the returned context, which is likely a bug causing incorrect context data.
findings.suggestion: Return the copied and updated config dictionary instead of the original. Change line 168 from "config": monitor_environment.monitor.config, to "config": config,
findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context returns unmodified config dict instead of updated copy

models.summary: The change refactors the mark_failed logic to delegate incident threshold handling to a new function try_incident_threshold in a new incidents.py module and moves issue occurrence creation to incident_occurrence.py. The main logic is preserved but split for clarity. One medium severity bug was found where get_monitor_environment_context returns the original config dict instead of the updated copy, causing incorrect context data.
